provider: Capture bytes exactly once. Validate V3 schema, qualified booleans, snapshot manifest and all listed member SHA/size/path, and exact approved V3 source SHA. Source authority is the existing qualified V3 provider; this consumer rechecks closed raw/metadata and does not issue grant or repeat full archive chunk restoration.
scope: 32 nonTag candidates, fixed8inputs by fullSHA; 16Tag safetyHOLD separate; no oldCORE32 population promotion.
strict_accepted_only: Only ACCEPTED_STRICT_ARCHIVE_RESTORE with accepted true triggers raw reads. Archived negatives/HOLD/pending remain actual distinct status, nullcycles, UNAVAILABLE counters; never failure performance or new retries.
counter_semantics: Frozen 9eed/02775 catalogue + literal source excerpt + immutable reviewed first8 data additive whitelist. Explicit monotone cumulative endpoints only. kernel gpu_sim_cycle/insn per print interval. Gauges/peaks/latency tokens not differenced. CH common and DH OO typed.
output: 32row JSON/CSV, Tag16, exact matched kernel cycles CSV, detailed gzip counters/explicit interval endpoints/latency tokens/gauges/peaks, matched delta facts and boundaries/recommendations, allsource pins. Each published member <=8MiB.
residency: Output must be new path under own snapshots; source/native/registry readonly. No subprocess/service/dispatch APIs in analysis CLI.
resource_design: Streaming raw gzip one line at time; per-source blocks retained (max33kernels in fixed8); parse each accepted source once per invocation. No giant trace read, no full archive tar re-audit. For repeat background calls Root may skip unchanged providerSHA; this CLI itself has no daemon.
